name: Tavus Tüyü
scene: a single shimmering peacock feather with its eye and flowing barbs
notes: Single feather in an oval panel, target 23–33 panes. Blue/turquoise subject and amber/terracotta background pairs. Visually inspected both generations; regenerated once to simplify the silhouette, separate top from rim and reduce crowded tips. Remaining doubts: subtle fill shading persists; several feather barbs taper narrowly toward the shaft and some eye/shaft contacts need tracing-stage review for short edges or multiway joins. No obvious loose line ends. Design sheet only; geometry and pane count not yet audited.
